name: Progress
title: Progress
summary: Bars and rings that show how far along a task is, from a file download to day 15 of a reading plan to step 1 of 2 in a sign-up.
whenToUse: Use a determinate bar when you know the total: downloads, uploads, a giving goal.
Use the indeterminate bar for work of unknown length that runs longer than about 2 seconds, at the top of a panel or page.
Use the circular ring for compact spots: an upload thumbnail, a reading plan in a list.
Use step progress at the top of a multi-step form (partner sign-up, giving).
Use a Loader spinner for short waits with no measurable progress.

anatomy.description: Track + fill, with an optional label row (name left, percent right) and a hint line below.

props.name: value
props.description: Current value, from 0 to `max`. Omit (or set `indeterminate`) when the length of the work is unknown.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Unknown length: a looping 35% bar with no `aria-valuenow`. Use for work longer than about 2 seconds.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible name of the task: a verb and the object, for example "Downloading Amharic audio Bible". Names the bar.

props.name: valueText
props.description: Text shown on the right of the label row, for example "68%". Defaults to the percentage when `label` is set.

props.name: hideValue
props.description: Hide the percentage next to the label. Show it only when it is accurate.

props.name: hint
props.description: Hint line below the bar, for example "412 MB of 600 MB · about 2 minutes left".

props.name: 'aria-label'
props.description: Accessible name when there is no visible `label`.

props.name: value
props.description: Current value from 0 to `max`. Ignored when `indeterminate`.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Work of unknown length (longer than about 2 seconds). Leaves the value out of the accessibility info.

props.name: label
props.description: Task name: verb and object, "Downloading Amharic audio Bible". Also the accessible name.

props.name: valueText
props.description: Right-hand text such as "68%". Defaults to the percent when `label` is set and the bar is determinate. Pass `null` to hide.

props.name: hint
props.description: Hint line below: amount and time, "412 MB of 600 MB".

variants.notes: 3px stroke, r 9.5, dasharray 59.7; text beside it

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Track `--gray-200`, fill `--horizon-blue`, radius `--radius-xs`. Never use status colours for normal progress.
4px by default; 8px (`.fb-track-lg`) only when a label sits above it.
Rings start at 12 o’clock (the SVG is rotated −90°) with round caps.
Animate width changes (0.3s); never jump backwards except on a restart.
Show the percent only when it is accurate. Add a hint line with size and time left when known.
Step progress: label left ("Step 1 of 2"), bar fills one share per step. Use it only for two to five steps.
When the task finishes, replace the bar with a success Toast or the next screen. When it fails, show an Alert or Toast with Retry.

accessibility: Every bar and ring has `role="progressbar"` and an accessible name (`aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`).
Step progress uses step numbers for the values (`aria-valuenow="1" aria-valuemax="2"`) and the visible label as its name.
Do not announce every percent change. Announce start and finish through a polite live region.
SVG rings are `aria-hidden="true"`; the wrapper carries the role and values.
Reduced motion: the indeterminate bar stops; keep the label so the state is still clear.
content: Name the task with a verb and the object: "Downloading Amharic audio Bible", "Uploading photo".
Hint line: amount and time, plain. "412 MB of 600 MB · about 2 minutes left" (sample figures).
Steps: "Step 1 of 2". Do not add step names to the bar; put them in the page heading.
